app_store.name: Helmroom: Quiz Your Way
app_store.subtitle: Quizzes you control
app_store.promotional_text: Write a quiz, set the time per question, and run it live or as homework. Students join with a code, no accounts.
app_store.description:
Helmroom is a quiz tool where the teacher sets the rules.

Write a quiz with five question types. Give each question the time it needs, from 5 seconds to 5 minutes. Run it live with you moving the class on, let each student go at their own pace, or send it home with a due date and a number of attempts.

Students join with a code and a name. They don't need an account.

What you get:
- Multiple choice, multiple answers, poll, fill in the blank and open-ended questions
- A live leaderboard
- Results per student and per question, with a CSV download
- Edit a quiz any time. A game already running keeps the version it started with

Helmroom stores a student's display name, answers and score for the game they join, and nothing else.
